name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx as an SSL-enabled multi-site web server for three sites, including static content, virtual hosts, TLS certificates, security headers, rate limiting, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and Fedora-specific runtime configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs prerequisites for a FastAPI application, initializes PostgreSQL, deploys the application source and Python environment, creates the application database and user, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
